This '''asteroid field''' was located in [[the galaxy]] on the edge of [[Guavian Drift|Guavian Death Space]], a region controlled by the [[Guavian Death Gang]]. During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], the ''[[Colossus]]'', passing through Guavian space, traveled through the [[asteroid field]] in an attempt to exit the region without being noticed by the criminal organization. After the [[space station]] was spotted and reported by a Guavian scout, its defending forces fought a [[Skirmish in Guavian Death Space|skirmish]] with Guavian forces on the edge of the asteroid field.<ref name="Kaz's Curse" />
